subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Battery Consumption Testing
description: A quick, practical guide to Battery Consumption Testing.

hook.text: A fitness app drains 40% battery in one hour. Users uninstall it because it kills their phone by noon.

buildup.text: Mobile apps that drain battery get poor reviews, angry users, and app store warnings.

discovery.text: Battery testing measures consumption during active use, background operation, and idle states.

twist.text: Background processes are the worst offenders. An app doing nothing visible can still drain battery fast.

climax.text: Profiling reveals a background location update runs every 5 seconds. Changing to every 5 minutes cuts drain by 80%.

punchline.text: Users notice battery drain before bugs. Optimize and test power usage.
